short: Reaches the goal: encrypts, destroys or alters data, stops operations.
analogy: Doesn’t steal — changes the locks and demands a ransom for the new keys, or just smashes everything.

solutionNotes.edr: Stops encryption on the first few files and rolls back the changes.
solutionNotes.backup: Brings data back without paying a ransom — as long as the copies are out of the attacker’s reach.
solutionNotes.siem: Spots preparation for the strike: deleted backups, stopped services.
solutionNotes.soar: Automatically isolates infected computers so the encryption doesn’t spread.
solutionNotes.ddos: Keeps the website available during a DDoS attack.
solutionNotes.dfir: Helps understand the scale and recover safely.
